title: NASA Challenge Tests Wheel Designs for Moon Base Mobility
description: As NASA prepares to establish the Moon Base, advancing surface mobility will be key to helping crews and robotic systems travel farther across the lunar surface.  To help advance that capability, the Rock and Roll with NASA Challenge invited public innovators to design and build next-generation lunar rover wheels.  Five teams from 128 submissions and 49 countries advanced to the final phase of the […]
tags: Center of Excellence for Collaborative Innovation (CoECI)
